Parity-gate interaction is understood and benign with the base-key approach (key sets stay identical across packs).
- **Dedup**: repo-scoped search returns only this card and #3865 (same hook, different defect — consumer-side defaults table vs. locale slot coverage; disjoint fixes, cross-linked).
